chain.label: Aft center-of-gravity test configuration
chain.trigger: The test required that the airplane be configured with an aft center of gravity (c.g.)

chain.label: Unbaffled, interconnected fuel tank design
chain.trigger: the auxiliary fuel tank system...were not isolated from each other by shutoff valves or check valves

chain.label: Inadequate Bombardier flight-test oversight and risk assessment
chain.trigger: Bombardier's oversight of its flight test program was inadequate because risk assessment procedures in place for the Challenger program were not followed

chain.label: Inexperienced pilot assigned an unfamiliar complex maneuver
chain.trigger: a relatively inexperienced flight test pilot was chosen for a flight that involved a complex maneuver he had never flown

caused_by.evidence: Bombardier's operation of its flight test program was deficient because...a relatively inexperienced flight test pilot was chosen for a flight that involved a complex maneuver he had never flown

chain.label: Fuel migrated aft through tanks during takeoff roll, shifting c.g. further aft
chain.trigger: the airplane's c.g. increased to 40.5 percent MAC by the time it reached a 13.8° pitch angle

caused_by.evidence: the CL-604's center fuel tank design allowed for significant fuel migration above the range accounted for in the airplane's certified c.g. range limits
the c.g. moved aft as the airplane accelerated down the runway as fuel shifted rearward in the auxiliary fuel tanks, tail tanks, and wing tanks

chain.label: Pilot commanded excessive rotation/pitch rate
chain.trigger: the airplane's maximum pitch rate after rotation was 9.6° per second, an extremely rapid pitch rate...approximately three times greater than the average 3° per second pitch rate recommended

caused_by.evidence: the pilot's practice of high rotation rate takeoffs...becomes even more critical in airplanes configured with aft c.g.'s
the company failed to identify a history of its pilots' practice of high rotation rate takeoffs

chain.label: Airplane stalled after rotation
chain.trigger: the vane AOA reached 23°...This angle was 4° above the normal setting for stick shaker activation

caused_by.evidence: the aft c.g., including the c.g. change during the takeoff phase, combined with the high pitch attitude and pitch rate commanded by the pilot, resulted in stall and loss of control
combined with the high pitch attitude and pitch rate commanded by the pilot, resulted in stall

chain.label: Loss of control in pitch/roll at low altitude
chain.trigger: the airplane began an uncommanded right roll just before reaching peak pitch attitude

caused_by.evidence: the second combination of stall, stick pusher activation and subsequent up elevator inputs by the pilot occurred at an altitude too low for recovery

chain.label: Ground impact and postimpact fire during initial climb
chain.trigger: the airplane's right wing rolled and impacted the ground first and that the airplane exploded on impact

caused_by.evidence: destroyed on impact with terrain and postimpact fire during initial climb from runway 19R

chain.label: Insufficient ARFF staffing for simultaneous firefighting and rescue
chain.trigger: there were not sufficient ARFF personnel equipped with protective gear in the immediate response to fight the fires and perform a rescue

chain.label: Fatal injuries to flight crew
chain.trigger: The pilot and flight test engineer were killed. The copilot was seriously injured and died 36 days later

caused_by.evidence: destroyed on impact with terrain and postimpact fire...The pilot and flight test engineer were killed
additional personnel during the initial response would have allowed them to suppress the cockpit fire more quickly
